title: 1.Bộ 5 đề thi giữa kì 1 Tiếng Anh 11 Global Success có đáp án

questions.content: Câu 1: What did Matt love doing in his free time?
options: A. Watching TV and playing video games
B. Hanging out at fast food restaurants
C. Spending time with his family

questions.content: Câu 2: Why does Matt want to live healthier?
options: A. He has just moved to live with his extended family.
B. His grandfather passed away.
C. His uncle was diagnosed with a heart disease.

questions.content: Câu 3: How does Matt eat more healthily?
options: A. He stops eating foods with fat and salt.
B. He wakes up earlier to have breakfast.
C. He has a quick breakfast before going to school.

questions.content: Câu 4: What does Math pay more attention to?
options: A. His appearance
B. His fitness
C. His heart condition

questions.content: Câu 5: Why does Matt go to cooking class?
options: A. Because there’s no fast food restaurant near his college.
B. Because he thinks he should know how to cook.
C. Because he wants to spend time with his mother.
questions.note: Choose B Script: Matt is a sixteen-year-old student who is trying to live healthier. Like many boys of his own age, Matt loved watching TV and playing video games in his free time. Skipping breakfast or having fast food for dinner was not uncommon for Matt. He lives with his extended family. His uncle has just found out he has a heart disease, the same condition that Matt's late grandfather suffered from. This news has pushed Matt to make some changes to his lifestyle. He's having a more balanced diet with less fat and salt. Even when he's late for school, Matt now tries to make time for a healthy breakfast. He also pays more attention to his fitness and works out properly. Now he's happy with his progress toward a healthier life but Matt's also thinking of the future. In a few years, Matt will leave for college and live an independent life. In order to stay healthy, Matt believes he should learn how to cook and must not rely on fast food in college. That's why he has recently signed up for a cooking class and spent more time in the kitchen with his mother.

questions.content: Câu 6: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A. The development of the generation gap in America nowadays.
B. The alleviation of the generation gap in America nowadays.
C. The eradication of the generation gap in America in the past.
D. The reduction of the generation gap in America in the past.

questions.content: Câu 7: What does the word they in line 8 mean?
options: A. Teenagers.
B. Forms of social media.
C. Parents.
D. Older generations

questions.content: Câu 8: According to the passage, what types of social media provided young people with new ideas in the 1960s?
options: A. The Internet and television.
B. The Internet and radios.
C. The television and printed newspaper.
D. The television and radios.
